```{r, message = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(recipes)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(randomForest)
library(corrplot)
library(glmnet)
library(FSelectorRcpp)
```

```{r}
tumors_df <- read_csv("tumors_df.csv")
tumors_train <- read_csv("tumors_train.csv")
tumors_test <- read_csv("tumors_test.csv")
```

#Training/Test Split
```{r}
set.seed(687)
#split_index <- createDataPartition(tumors_df$Class, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
#train_data <- tumors_df[split_index, ]
#test_data <- tumors_df[-split_index, ]

train_data <- tumors_train
test_data <- tumors_test
```

#Feature Selection
```{r}
#remove near-zero variance predictors
nzv <- nearZeroVar(train_data[, -1], saveMetrics = TRUE)
filtered_train <- train_data[, c(TRUE, !nzv$nzv)]
filtered_test <- test_data[, c(TRUE, !nzv$nzv)]

#Select top N features
set.seed(999)
info_gain <- information_gain(Class ~., data = filtered_train)
top_features <- info_gain %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>% #take the 100 most informative genes
  pull(attributes)

train_selected <- filtered_train %>%
  select(all_of(c("Class", top_features)))

test_selected <- filtered_test %>%
  select(all_of(c("Class", top_features)))

#clarify that we know this is a classification task
train_selected$Class <- as.factor(train_selected$Class)
test_selected$Class <- as.factor(test_selected$Class)

#fix factor level names
levels(train_selected$Class) <- make.names(levels(train_selected$Class))
levels(test_selected$Class) <- make.names(levels(test_selected$Class))
```

#Preprocessing
```{r}
model_recipe <- recipe(Class ~., data = train_selected) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors())

prepped_recipe <- prep(model_recipe, training = train_selected)
train_processed <- bake(prepped_recipe, new_data = train_selected)
test_processed <- bake(prepped_recipe, new_data = test_selected)
```

#KNN Tuning
```{r}
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  savePredictions = "final",
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = multiClassSummary
)

k_values <- data.frame(k = seq(1, 21, by = 2))
```

#Train model
```{r, warning = FALSE}
library(MLmetrics)
set.seed(789)
knn_model <- train(
  x = train_processed %>% select(-Class),
  y = train_processed$Class,
  method = "knn",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = k_values,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)
print(knn_model)
```

#Eval on test set
```{r}
test_predictions <- predict(knn_model, newdata = test_processed %>% select(-Class))
conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(test_predictions, test_processed$Class)
print(conf_matrix)
knn_results_df <- data.frame(
  Actual = test_selected$Class,
  Predicted = test_predictions
)
```

#Confusion Matrix
```{r}
cm <- knn_results_df %>%
  count(Actual, Predicted) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Confusion Matrix - KNN", x = "True Label", y = "Predicted Label")
print(cm)

```


#Accuracy by Class
```{r}
accuracy_by_class <- knn_results_df %>%
  group_by(Actual) %>%
  summarize(
    Total = n(),
    Correct = sum(as.character(Actual) == as.character(Predicted)),
    Accuracy = Correct / Total
  )

ggplot(accuracy_by_class, aes(x = Actual, y = Accuracy, fill = Actual)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Accuracy)), vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Accuracy by Tumor Class", y = "Accuracy", x = "Tumor Class") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1))

```

#Error Rate vs K
```{r}
tuning_plot <- ggplot(knn_model) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = knn_model$results$k) +
  labs(title = "KNN Model Accuracy by k Value", x = "Number of Neighbors", y = "Accuracy")

print(tuning_plot)

```

#PCA Preprocessing
```{r}
#retain PCs that explain 95% of the variance
pca_recipe <- recipe(Class ~ ., data = filtered_train) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_pca(all_predictors(), threshold = 0.95)

pca_prep <- prep(pca_recipe, training = filtered_train)
train_pca <- bake(pca_prep, new_data = filtered_train)
test_pca <- bake(pca_prep, new_data = filtered_test)

#convert outcome --> factor + fix level names
train_pca$Class <- as.factor(train_pca$Class)
test_pca$Class <- as.factor(test_pca$Class)
levels(train_pca$Class) <- make.names(levels(train_pca$Class))
levels(test_pca$Class) <- make.names(levels(test_pca$Class))

```

#Train PCA-based model
```{r, warning = FALSE}
set.seed(789)
knn_pca_model <- train(
  x = train_pca %>% select(-Class),
  y = train_pca$Class,
  method = "knn",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = k_values,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)
print(knn_pca_model)
```

#Eval on test set
```{r}
pca_predictions <- predict(knn_pca_model, newdata = test_pca %>% select(-Class))
pca_predictions <- factor(pca_predictions, levels = levels(test_pca$Class))
pca_conf_matrix <- confusionMatrix(pca_predictions, test_pca$Class)
print(pca_conf_matrix)

pca_results_df <- data.frame(
  Actual = test_pca$Class,
  Predicted = pca_predictions
)
```

```{r}
pca_cm <- pca_results_df %>%
  count(Actual, Predicted) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "tomato") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Confusion Matrix - PCA + KNN", x = "True Label", y = "Predicted Label")
print(pca_cm)
```

```{r}
pca_accuracy_by_class <- pca_results_df %>%
  group_by(Actual) %>%
  summarize(
    Total = n(),
    Correct = sum(as.character(Actual) == as.character(Predicted)),
    Accuracy = Correct / Total
  )

ggplot(pca_accuracy_by_class, aes(x = Actual, y = Accuracy, fill = Actual)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Accuracy)), vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Accuracy by Tumor Class (PCA)", y = "Accuracy", x = "Tumor Class") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1))
```
#Comp accuracy by clas
```{r}
knn_accuracy_by_class <- knn_results_df %>%
  group_by(Actual) %>%
  summarize(
    Total = n(),
    Correct = sum(as.character(Actual) == as.character(Predicted)),
    Accuracy = Correct / Total
  )
pca_accuracy_by_class <- pca_results_df %>%
  group_by(Actual) %>%
  summarize(
    Total = n(),
    Correct = sum(as.character(Actual) == as.character(Predicted)),
    Accuracy = Correct / Total
  )

ggplot(pca_accuracy_by_class, aes(x = Actual, y = Accuracy, fill = Actual)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(Accuracy)), vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Accuracy by Tumor Class (PCA)", y = "Accuracy", x = "Tumor Class") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1))
```


```{r}
svm_results_df <- read_csv("svm_preds.csv")
svm_results_df$Actual <- pca_results_df$Actual  # Copy the Actual values
svm_results_df$Predicted <- paste0("X", svm_results_df$preds) 
svm_results_df$Model <- "SVM"  # Add Model column
svm_results_df <- svm_results_df[, c("Actual", "Predicted", "Model")]

```

#Compare approaches
```{r}
common_levels <- Reduce(union, list(
  levels(knn_results_df$Actual), 
  levels(pca_results_df$Actual), 
  levels(svm_results_df$Actual)
))

#knn
knn_results_df$Actual <- factor(knn_results_df$Actual, levels = common_levels)
knn_results_df$Predicted <- factor(knn_results_df$Predicted, levels = common_levels)

#pca
pca_results_df$Actual <- factor(pca_results_df$Actual, levels = common_levels)
pca_results_df$Predicted <- factor(pca_results_df$Predicted, levels = common_levels)

#svm
svm_results_df$Actual <- factor(svm_results_df$Actual, levels = common_levels)
svm_results_df$Predicted <- factor(svm_results_df$Predicted, levels = common_levels)

knn_results_df$Model <- "KNN"
pca_results_df$Model <- "KNN w/ PCA"

combined_results <- bind_rows(knn_results_df, 
                              pca_results_df,
                              svm_results_df)

#confusion matrix
cm_plot <- combined_results %>%
  count(Model, Actual, Predicted) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ Model) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrix Comparison: Top Features vs PCA",
    x = "True Label",
    y = "Predicted Label"
  )

print(cm_plot)

#accuracy by class
accuracy_df <- combined_results %>%
  group_by(Model, Actual) %>%
  summarize(
    Total = n(),
    Correct = sum(Actual == Predicted),
    Accuracy = Correct / Total,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

accuracy_plot <- ggplot(accuracy_df, aes(x = Actual, y = Accuracy, fill = Model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy by Tumor Class",
    y = "Accuracy",
    x = "Tumor Class"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1))

print(accuracy_plot)

#accuracy comp
overall_accuracy <- combined_results %>%
  mutate(Correct = Actual == Predicted) %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarize(Accuracy = mean(Correct))

print(overall_accuracy)

#line plot
ggplot(accuracy_df, aes(x = Actual, y = Accuracy, color = Model, group = Model)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy by Tumor Class and Model",
    y = "Accuracy",
    x = "Tumor Class"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1))

#transparent bar
ggplot(accuracy_df, aes(x = Actual, y = Accuracy, fill = Model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy by Tumor Class",
    y = "Accuracy",
    x = "Tumor Class"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1))
```

